subject: AcmeCloud vendor setup: kickoff & PO process checklist
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Sanchez <elena.sanchez@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: vendor setup & PO workflow (AcmeCloud)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the vendor setup for AcmeCloud. To get you set up in our procurement system and enable POs, we need a short set of items from your side and we'll outline what we (Redwood) will do.

What we need from you (high priority):
- Completed vendor onboarding form (see link/attachment)
- W-9 (or local tax form) for your legal entity (PDF)
- Bank details or ACH remediation form for payments (bank name, account, routing)
- Primary invoice contact + invoice header details
- Signed MSA or proposed redlines (DocuSign or Word)

What we will do:
- Create supplier record in our procurement system and issue supplier code (S-XXXXX)
- Raise PO once supplier is active (typical lead time 1-3 business days after activation)
- Provide PO template and payment terms (Net 30 by default)
- Configure billing contact and delivery instructions in Coupa (internal)

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (blank), onboarding checklist (doc)

Could you confirm expected turnaround on the W-9 and bank details? Also if you have any standard PO requirements (payment terms, tax withholding, country-specific invoicing), flag them now so we can route approval.

If helpful, I can schedule a 20-minute sync later this week to walk through the form. Proposed time: Thu Feb 19, 11:00 AM PT.

Thanks —

Dylan Brooks
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Elena Sanchez <elena.sanchez@acmecloud.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Feb 2026 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor setup & PO workflow (AcmeCloud)

Hi Dylan / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear list. Attached are our scanned W-9 and a filled vendor onboarding form (vendor_onboarding_form_filled.xlsx). We can provide bank details — would you prefer an ACH form or can we email bank details to procure@redwood.ai?

A couple of quick questions:
1) Do you require the MSA to be executed via DocuSign or is a signed PDF enough?
2) We typically request Net 45 on initial orders for new enterprise customers — is Net 30 firm?

We have a few minor MSA redlines we want to propose; I attached a draft (acme_msa_redlines.docx). Happy to discuss on the call if needed.

Best,
Elena Sanchez
Sr. Procurement Manager
AcmeCloud, Inc.
elena.sanchez@acmecloud.com
+1 (212) 555-0199

Attachments: W-9_AcmeCloud.pdf, vendor_onboarding_form_filled.xlsx, acme_msa_redlines.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Sanchez <elena.sanchez@acmecloud.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor setup & PO workflow (AcmeCloud)

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifications from procurement ops:

- DocuSign vs Signed PDF: Either is acceptable. DocuSign speeds approvals when legal needs to countersign. If you send Word redlines we can track via DocuSign after legal review.
- Payment terms: Net 30 is our standard for new suppliers. Net 45 would need approval from Finance; please include justification (credit references / reasons) and we can route.
- Bank details: please upload the ACH/bank form to the secure Drive link below or send to procure@redwood.ai (we'll require a voided check or bank letter for verification).
- Tax withholding: If you are US-based and W-9 is on file, standard withholding applies; any foreign entity paperwork will need W-8BEN-E.

Next steps (procurement owner = Marissa):
1) I will kick off supplier creation once we receive the completed bank form + W-9.
2) Finance will perform bank verification (1 business day).
3) Supplier code issued (S-12784) and we'll notify Dylan.
4) Sales/Account team sends PO request with quote/sku for the first order.

Shared links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AcmeOnboard (upload bank form)

I'll coordinate internally with Finance for any term exceptions if needed.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Elena Sanchez <elena.sanchez@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor setup & PO workflow (AcmeCloud)

Thanks Marissa —

We will upload the ACH form to the Drive link today. A quick note on the MSA redlines: the language we redlined is around indemnification limits and data handling (we have a standard clause we prefer). I've attached the redlines as a Word doc (acme_msa_redlines.docx). Let me know if Legal at Redwood wants to swap track changes into your template or if DocuSign review is preferred.

Also: invoice header should read: AcmeCloud, Inc. / 120 Market St / San Francisco, CA — please ensure that matches the PO.

Elena

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Sanchez <elena.sanchez@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor setup & PO workflow (AcmeCloud)

Elena —

Appreciate the materials and the redlines. Consolidated checklist below (I attached a one-page PDF as well):

Action items for AcmeCloud (owner = Elena):
- Upload ACH/bank verification + voided check to Drive (due EOD Feb 18)
- Confirm preferred payment terms request (Net 45) and provide justification if you want Finance to consider (optional)
- Confirm invoice header and primary AP email for PDF invoices
- Indicate preference for DocuSign or signed PDF for MSA

Action items for Redwood (owners = Marissa / Finance / Legal):
- Create supplier record and initiate bank verification once ACH form received (Marissa)
- Review MSA redlines and respond with counterproposal or acceptance (Legal)
- Issue supplier code and enable PO creation (Procurement)
- Notify when PO is raised and share PO number + template (Dylan to coordinate with sales ops)

Meeting: I'll schedule the 20-min sync Thu Feb 19, 11:00 AM PT; invite to follow. If you prefer earlier, propose a time.

Links & artifacts: HubSpot company record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890; Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AcmeOnboard; DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcdef

Attachments: consolidated_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Thanks —
